intro: Kosovo is a parliamentary republic recognised by many, but not all, countries.

chapters.title: Assembly and president
text: The 120-member Assembly reserves 20 seats for minority communities. The president is elected by the Assembly. Kosovo uses the euro, although it is not in the EU.

chapters.title: Relations with Serbia
text: Talks between Kosovo and Serbia, led by the EU, aim to normalise relations, but tensions, especially in the Serb-majority north, often flare up. NATO peacekeepers have been stationed in Kosovo since 1999.

keyTerms.meaning: International troops sent to keep the peace.
